about: longarcs.py: the long-arc model, the felt strength (the sides over the whole slide, F65.6), the four trials

slide.basis: hand model: the heel placement (palm on the hump, fingers relaxed) to the lifted (zero-g, tips on the buttons); derived

path.rule: G4: each side valley's bottom on its finger's path as you grip, from where it lands (palm on the hump) to where it grips (palm lifted); no cost on it, ((mm off) / 2)^2 off it
